ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a ternary coordinate diagram, and the three sides respectively correspond to the percentage scales of the three location factors a, b, and c. The figure marks the four industrial types Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding, among which Jia is located on the side close to the high values of factor a, Yi is closer to the high-value direction of factor b, and Bing and Ding are located in relatively central or upper positions. Then reason: The question stem states that a, b, and c respectively represent labor, raw materials, and technology. To determine which industrial type is most likely to experience a “labor shortage,” one should compare the degree of dependence of the four industrial types on the labor factor a. In the figure, Jia has the largest proportion of factor a, indicating that Jia depends most on labor, and therefore is most likely to experience a labor shortage.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一个三角坐标图，三个方向分别表示a、b、c三种区位因素的百分比，内部标出甲、乙、丙、丁四种工业类型。再按题干把a对应为劳动力，沿a因素的刻度线读取或比较四类工业的a百分比。图上甲所在区域的a因素比重最大，说明甲最依赖劳动力，因此最容易出现“用工荒”。
